Septic marketplace

Being at "Parhon", the obese ward was surprisingly good. It is a national institute after all. If I would've been in a filthy hospital, I'd have a better story, I'd have things to criticize. Another one someone with socks. Yet another one with panties as big as Santa's sack. Then a man threw a bunch of books on my bed. Only cheesy novels. I said thanks, but no, I have high blood sugar. Someone else was selling crosswords and pens. What can I say, it was good commercial commotion. It breaks the monotony of a white and aseptic hospital. It made it feel alive.
